prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Welcome Back to Your Pets", "Sign in to access and sync your existing desktop pets safely.", "Cloud Sync Active - Pet History Saved"]
1: ["Desktop Preview & Screen Check", "Confirming your desktop display setup for seamless pet rendering.", "Desktop Preview", "Confirm Display"]
2: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Learn how to command, hide, and talk to your new pet right from your desktop.", "Quick Controls Guide"]
3: ["Your Companion Journey Begins"]
4: ["Use clear, well-lit front photos for best pet generation quality.", "Tips: High resolution, bright lighting, single pet in frame."]
5: ["Tip: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open quick controls."]
6: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your new companion a name to finalize adoption.", "Certificate Ready"]
7: ["If the screen stalls, check your internet connection and click retry.", "Connection Status: Ready"]
8: ["Your Companion is Ready + Free Welcome Gift!", "Complete setup to unlock a free starter hat accessory for your pet.", "Unlocked: Starter Accessory Pack"]
9: ["Preset path takes 1 min; Custom photo creation takes 3 mins."]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free gifts and free extras.
